subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should the pnpm dependency-verification opt-out remain CI-wide, or be limited to the boundary commands after explicit dependency setup?
rationale: The Signal fix is narrow, but the workflow-level environment change alters pnpm 11 behavior for every CI job and is broader than the stated boundary-shard failure.

options.title: Scope the CI opt-out
options.body: Limit the setting to the affected commands or jobs after explicit dependency setup so unrelated CI work keeps pnpm’s default dependency verification.

options.title: Accept CI-wide policy
options.body: Keep the workflow-level setting only after the CI owner confirms that every affected pnpm invocation has an intentional validated dependency path.

recommendation.title: Scope the CI opt-out
recommendation.body: Limit the setting to the affected commands or jobs after explicit dependency setup so unrelated CI work keeps pnpm’s default dependency verification.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main CI history shows sustained ownership of the workflow’s pnpm and shard behavior.
